verdict.rationale: ClickUp can bring some outside work items into its own workspace: it syncs GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket issues and PRs into tasks, and Sentry errors become tasks. Asana and Jira are only one-time imports or migrations, not live aggregation of tasks from other project management tools. Missing for 10: a live unified 'my assigned tasks' view across Jira, Asana, Linear or other PM tools; ongoing two-way sync with competing PM tools; filtering by assignee across sources; hands-on corroboration.
